text:
Nina (People Ops): Heads up: Marco (portfolio review) arriving ~3:15pm with a portfolio tube + small terrarium. He's bringing his partner and a service dog (Pico). Partner prefers a low-traffic seat. Also a package from FedEx showed up for Suite 5B by mistake earlier. Kiosk flaky this morning. Can someone prep a manual badge flow and set out a mat for Pico? :dog::heart:

Sam (Front Desk): Copy. Kiosk intermittently timing out (504). I can do manual badges and fetch a dog mat. Where do you want the misdelivered package? It	is labeled "Acme / Suite 5B" but we	only have Suites 2/4/6 on the door.

DeliveryBot: ALERT: FedEx drop at 10:42am. Package: 1 box (label: Acme / Suite 5B). Courier note: left at front desk.

Luca: I	grabbed the box earlier, it's in Lost & Found (locker L2). I can drop it at Mailroom 5 for pickup by logistics.

Nina (People Ops): Perfect. Please tag it "misdelivered - notify logistics". For seating: low-traffic corner bench by the north window is best. Also, please avoid bright lamps for the dog.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (kiosk down):
```
# quick manual badge
/usr/local/bin/capture -o /tmp/marco.jpg --cam frontdesk
/usr/local/bin/mkb -n "Marco" -r Visitor -p /tmp/marco.jpg --ttl 4h > /tmp/marco_badge.pdf
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/marco_badge.pdf
```
Provisioning guest-wifi token for 4h.

BadgePrinterBot: NOTICE - printer queued at 3:12pm, estimated 10s.

Sam (Front Desk): Mat out, bench prepped, low lamp. Badge printed at 3:14pm, issuing now. :white_check_mark:

Luca: Box moved to Mailroom 5 and labeled. Left note for logistics: "Suite 5B - misdelivered".

Marco (Visitor): Thanks everyone! Pico is friendly and naps a lot. We	appreciate the quiet spot. Also, I taped a tiny spare hook inside the portfolio tube for hanging prints, labeled "hang - north beam".

Nina (People Ops): Noted and added to install notes. Quick poll for water: would you like a small bottle left on the side table? Reply :thumbsup: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no.

Marco (Visitor): :thumbsup: please.

Sam (Front Desk): Water placed. Marco checked in, ID verified, badge issued. Pico settled on mat. Lost package routed to Mailroom 5. All good.

Nina (People Ops): Great job team 1 min turnaround. Closing thread, thanks :raised_hands:
